'''Charles Kerekanich''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[June 2001 Oxford tournament]] on 9 June 2001, according to Carson Swanek's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2454">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-14-oxford-north-carolina-9-6-01d2454/ oxford-north-carolina-9-6-01], DeckTech (Carson "tarkinsaide" Swanek, 14 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-14-oxford-north-carolina-9-6-01d2454/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
